what_happened: The job to let `athena retry` re-verify a stale job's kept candidate on the new tip was rejected at the final verdict. One of 8 acceptance criteria was unmet: the criterion that docs/decisions.md record a decision reversing the left-out alternative (d), "Automatic re-verification on the new base", and annotate the original line 297 as reversed. There were two major findings and no blocker. First, the annotation clause cannot be met without breaking the append-only check on the decision log (docs/decisions.md:297, crates/athena-cli/src/decisions.rs:200). Second, the reading did not match the request, so passing criteria did not show the request was met. No checks failed.
cause: The reading wrote a criterion that edits an existing line of the decision log, but the log is append-only and decisions.rs enforces that. Nothing cross-checks a reading's criteria against that invariant, or against how the decisions page treats amendments, before the work runs. The request was also probably restated in a way that changed its meaning (the verifier says the reading misread it). The conflict was found only when the verifier judged the finished work.
prevention: Add a check at reading acceptance. Any criterion that names an existing line of docs/decisions.md for edit or annotation is refused, with a message saying to append a new superseding entry that cites the old one. The check should read the same rule that decisions.rs applies, so the two cannot drift. The reading should also be compared with the request's own wording before it is accepted.
proposed_request: Let `athena retry` re-verify a stale job's kept candidate on the new tip, so that stale landings caused by parallel jobs no longer need a re-ask. Outcome: retrying a job whose base has moved re-runs verification of its kept candidate on the current tip and reports the verdict, without rebuilding the work. Acceptance: (1) a test shows retry on a stale job with a kept candidate runs only verification on the new tip and does not call the producer; (2) a stale job with no kept candidate keeps today's behavior; (3) the verdict is recorded against the new tip; (4) docs/decisions.md gets a NEW appended decision that supersedes the left-out alternative (d) 'Automatic re-verification on the new base' of the landing decision, giving the reason that stale landings now recur with parallel jobs and citing the old decision by id. Do not edit or annotate any existing line of docs/decisions.md, because the log is append-only and decisions.rs checks that; (5) cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy --all-targets and cargo test pass.
